intro: Demo privacy notice, seeded by the Desiderio styleguide. It shows the structure of a GDPR-style notice. Replace every section with your own reviewed text before go-live.

sections.title: What we collect
sections.content: We collect the information you give us directly, such as your name, email address and account settings. We also collect basic technical data automatically, including your IP address, browser type and the pages you visit.

sections.title: How we use your data
sections.content:
We use your data to provide, secure and improve the service. In particular, we use it to:

  • Verify your login and keep your account secure
  • Send service updates and answer support requests
  • Measure performance and fix problems

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
sections.content: We use strictly necessary cookies to keep you signed in. Analytics cookies are optional and load only after you accept them. You can change your choice at any time with the cookie settings link in the footer.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.content: You can access, correct, export or delete your personal data at any time. To use any of these rights, email our privacy team. We respond within 30 days, as the GDPR requires.

sections.title: Contact us
sections.content: For questions about this demo notice, write to office@webconsulting.at or to the postal address in the imprint.
